description: This file defines the 'OptimizerExtension' class which is part of the Twig templating engine. It extends the 'AbstractExtension' class and provides node visitors for optimization purposes within Twig's compilation process.

classes.name: OptimizerExtension
classes.description: An extension for Twig that adds optimizer node visitors to enhance template compilation performance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with an optional number of optimizers to be used by the node visitor.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array containing an instance of OptimizerNodeVisitor configured with the current optimizers setting.
